test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 24 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following schemes come under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Make in India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Make in India:**

 
 
• **Make in India** is an initiative launched by the Government of India in September 2014 under the **Ministry of Commerce and Industry**.
 
• The scheme aims to transform India into a global manufacturing hub by encouraging both domestic and foreign companies to manufacture their products in India.
 
• It focuses on 25 sectors, including automobiles, textiles, electronics, and pharmaceuticals, to boost job creation and economic growth.
 
• The initiative also aims to improve ease of doing business and attract foreign direct investment (FDI).
 
• Make in India is a flagship program of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry to promote industrial development.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan:**

 
 
• **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan** (Clean India Mission) is a nationwide cleanliness campaign launched in October 2014.
 
• It is under the **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs** and the **Ministry of Jal Shakti**.
 
• The mission aims to eliminate open defecation, improve solid waste management, and promote cleanliness in rural and urban areas.
 
• It is one of the largest cleanliness drives in the world, with a focus on behavioral change and community participation.
 
• The scheme is not associated with the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
 
 
 
• **National Digital Health Mission:**
 
 
• The **National Digital Health Mission (NDHM)** was launched in August 2020 to create a digital health ecosystem in India.
 
• It is under the **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare**.
 
• The mission aims to provide a unique health ID, digital health records, and telemedicine services to citizens.
 
• It seeks to improve healthcare delivery and make health services more accessible and efficient.
 
• The NDHM is not related to the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
 
 
 
• **National Bal Swachhta Mission:**
 
 
• The **National Bal Swachhta Mission** is a cleanliness initiative focused on children and schools.
 
• It is part of the **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan** and is implemented by the **Ministry of Education**.
 
• The mission promotes cleanliness, hygiene, and sanitation among children through awareness programs and activities.
 
• It aims to instill the habit of cleanliness in young minds and create a cleaner environment in schools.
 
• This scheme is not under the purview of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
